name: table-of-figures
title: Table of figures
blurb: Six pages of a small study: two ruled tables, a bar chart, a scanned page and notes.
shows: A layout parser keeps each table row together, and a chart can only be read from its caption. Two questions are planted to miss: one answer is on a scanned page with no text, and one question uses words the document never does.

teaches.question: average-saving
teaches.why: The answer is on page 5, a scanned page with no text layer, so the parse has nothing to read there.
teaches.fix_text: In Parse, turn on OCR so the scanned page is read.

teaches.question: left-for-later
teaches.why: The question says paperwork and another time where the document says manuals, legal texts and a later study, so the search ranks the answer far below the 5 checked.
teaches.fix_text: In the search settings, rewrite the question with PRF, which borrows the document's own words.
